notes: TMA03 needs specific outage durations, different message rates, larger samples and multiple runs, but does not specify exact numbers.
The 100 ms delay and 10% loss scenario uses the exploratory impairment setting from TMA03.
Each scenario is tested three times.
Outage tests use controlled recovery after publishing. These tests do not claim concurrent live forwarding during the recovery process.
